user.title: ADT Pulse Credentials
user.description: Enter your ADT Pulse portal credentials. A device fingerprint is required for two-factor authentication.

data_description.fingerprint: Unique device identifier used by ADT Pulse 2FA. Obtain from your existing ADT mobile app session or the Homebridge ADT Pulse setup wizard.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials or fingerprint. Verify your username, password, and fingerprint.

abort.already_configured: ADT Pulse is already configured for this account.
